page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7t.3xlarge is a general-purpose virtual instance based on the x86_64 architecture, operating under a KVM hypervisor. It is powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at a base clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The hardware layout features 6 physical CPU cores with hyper-threading enabled, providing 12 dedicated vCPUs. Cache allocation includes 48 KB of L1d cache, 1 MB of L2 cache, and 48 MB of shared L3 cache. System memory totals 48.0 GB, establishing a 4.0 GB memory capacity per vCPU core. This instance type contains no integrated local NVMe storage and no GPU hardware accelerators, relying on network-attached storage and provisioned networking delivering an 8 Gbps baseline bandwidth.

Standardized synthetic benchmarks place the processing and memory subsystems within average operational tiers. CPU testing shows a stress-ng single-core result of 1881.48 and a multi-core score of 11646.62. Memory read throughput reaches 78.98 GB/sec on large uncached blocks, while large block write operations measure 52.5 GB/sec. Application-oriented tests display a static web serving throughput of 17.22 GB/sec and a Redis SET throughput of 12.02 million operations per second. Multi-threaded bzip3 decompression scores 64.09 GB/sec, and software compilation under Geekbench reaches 11749.0. Conversely, prompt processing performance for a 7B parameter LLM drops into the lower 25th percentile at 24.27 tokens per second, illustrating a bottleneck for unaccelerated machine learning workloads.

The hardware configuration of ecs.g7t.3xlarge yields a classic 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio suited for consistent, balanced resource distribution. Because it omits dedicated GPU devices and local disk arrays, the server maintains cost efficiency by focusing expenditure strictly on core compute and network connectivity. The server is suited for general web serving, relational database operations, software build pipelines, static content delivery, and enterprise backend application hosting.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7t.3xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine driven by a 2.7 GHz Intel Xeon 8369B processor built on x86_64 architecture. Utilizing KVM virtualization, it provides 12 vCPUs across 6 physical cores, 48 MB of L3 cache, and 48.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a 4.0 GB per vCPU ratio. The instance includes an 8 Gbps baseline network interface, zero local NVMe storage, and no GPU hardware accelerators. Benchmark evaluations place its single-core and multi-core CPU performance, memory throughput, and static web serving capacity (17.22 GB/sec) within average ranges. While handling Redis SET operations at 12.02 million ops/sec effectively, processing larger AI models shows throughput limitations without dedicated hardware acceleration. Overall, ecs.g7t.3xlarge delivers balanced resource density suitable for general web serving, software compilation, database administration, and routine application hosting workloads.
